attributes.title: Level 4

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about using array functions in your code to add, remove, and access data in your projects.

questions.hint: At what number do arrays begin indexing elements?
questions.title: [Select one] In the animals array, what element is at index 2?
questions.correctResponse: The index of elements in an array begins at 0 and increases by 1 with each element added. The element at index 0 is “cat”, index 1 is “hamster”, and index 2 is “dolphin”.

questions.hint: What does each function and property do in JavaScript?
questions.title: [Match one per answer] Match each function and property to its purpose below:

statements.text: The ________ function can be used to join all elements of an array into a single string value.
The _______ function can be used to join the values of 2 arrays into a new array with all of the values as elements.
The _______ function can be used to remove the last element from an array.
The _______ function can be used to add an element to the end of an array
The _______ function can be used to remove the first element from an array.

questions.correctResponse: You can find many different functions to modify and gain information about arrays in the code completion tool. Just type the array and a dot operator to view all of the possible functions.

questions.hint: What does the concat function do in JavaScript?
questions.title: [Select one] What are the elements of the doubleColors array after the .concat function runs?
questions.correctResponse: The concat function concatenates, or joins, the values of 2 arrays into a new array with all of the values as elements.

questions.hint: What does the pop function do in JavaScript?
questions.title: [Select one] What will the elements of the colors array be after the pop function runs?
questions.correctResponse: Since the pop function removes the last element from an array, only the first 2 elements will be left.

questions.hint: At what number do arrays begin indexing elements at? Where are the elements in the nested array drawn from?
questions.title: [Select one] In the nestedCreatures nested array, what element is at index 1?
questions.correctResponse: Index 0 of the nestedCreatures array contains the first array of elements. Index 1 of the nestedCreatures array contains the second array of elements. Index 2 of the nestedCreatures array contains the third array of elements. Each value is drawn from a specific index in the adjectives, colors, and animals arrays.

subgroups.title: Array Functions!
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about using array functions in your code to add, remove, and access data in your projects.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 4 of Purple Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about arrays and array functions. You’ll build on your understanding of arrays in JavaScript by exploring functions that will help you access, modify, and join elements in an array. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 4:

badges.title: Push It, Pop It, Join It, Concat It!
badges.description: Use several different array functions in JavaScript to access and modify the data stored inside an array.

badges.title: A String of Numbers
badges.description: Use the toString function to convert a number to a string

badges.title: Arrays All The Way Down
badges.description: Create a nested array in JavaScript.

badges.title: Joined at the Hip
badges.description: Use the join function to join all the elements of a string array into one string value.

badges.title: Together Forever
badges.description: Use the concat function to join two arrays together into one new array.

badges.title: Pop It Like It’s Hot
badges.description: Use the pop function to remove and return the last element from an array.

badges.title: Group Project
badges.description: Use the allOfKind function to create an array of all sprites of the specified sprite kind.
